proof: Rotational symmetry preserves a square. Relative velocity projected onto a side is -v: the chaser contributes -v and the target, moving along the perpendicular next side, contributes zero. Thus side length is L-vt until meeting, T=L/v, path length vT=L. Analytic positions r=(L/sqrt(2))q, angle=theta0-log(q), q=1-vt/L have speed v and aim at the next corner. The displayed truncation q=.008 is explicitly identified; the exact trajectory has infinitely many turns in finite time.
